items.title: ونگر از رقابت با اینفانتینو برای ریاست فیفا کنار کشید
items.summary: آرسن ونگر، سرمربی پیشین آرسنال و مدیر توسعه جهانی فوتبال در فیفا، تصمیم گرفت در انتخابات ریاست این نهاد نامزد نشود و با جیانی اینفانتینو رقابت نکند.
items.titleEn: Wenger has withdrawn from the competition with Infantino for the presidency of FIFA.
items.summaryEn: Arsene Wenger, former head coach of Arsenal and FIFA's director of world football development, has decided not to run for president of the organisation and not to compete with Gianni Infantino.

items.titleEn: Mahdi Taj: Because of sanctions, we can't get money from FIFA and AFC.
items.summaryEn: Mehdi Taj, the president of the Iranian Football Federation, said that due to the sanctions, it is not possible to obtain financial resources from FIFA and the Asian Football Confederation and that a solution is to be found with FIFA officials.
